The harmonic nature of this process involves spectral decomposition of residual deviations across bookmakers. Player efficiency regression models the interplay between target load and execution under stress, using σ-deviations to quantify reliability. Total grind model reflects the inverse relationship between defensive intensity and scoring potential. These primitives form a dualistic framework: one rooted in probabilistic inference (GSI), the other in situational logic (GSE). Failure modes include market inefficiencies, stale data, and misalignment of player regression coefficients with actual performance.
